WITH high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.name,
    s.nces_id,
    s.low_grade_served,
    s.high_grade_served,
    s.low_grade_enrolled,
    s.high_grade_enrolled,
    s.status,
    s.grade12_enrollment
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.nces_district_id = '0613360'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.high_grade_enrolled = 12
    AND COALESCE(s.grade12_enrollment,0) > 0
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sc.school_id,
    SUM(sc.num_test_takers) AS total_sat_takers
  FROM satscores sc
  GROUP BY sc.school_id
),
eligible_high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    hs.school_id,
    hs.name,
    hs.low_grade_served,
    hs.high_grade_served,
    hs.low_grade_enrolled,
    hs.high_grade_enrolled
  FROM high_schools hs
  LEFT JOIN sat_counts satc ON hs.school_id = satc.school_id
  WHERE COALESCE(satc.total_sat_takers, 0) = 0
),
ordered_grades AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(low_grade_enrolled) IN ('prekindergarten','pre-k','prek','preschool') THEN 0
      WHEN lower(low_grade_enrolled) = 'kindergarten' THEN 1
      WHEN lower(low_grade_enrolled) = 'k' THEN 1
      WHEN CAST(low_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(low_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER)
      ELSE 99 -- unknown or other grades far down
    END AS start_grade_order
  FROM eligible_high_schools
),
min_start_grade AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_grade_order) AS min_order FROM ordered_grades
)
SELECT
  og.name AS school_name,
  og.low_grade_enrolled AS grade_span_start,
  og.high_grade_enrolled AS grade_span_end
FROM ordered_grades og, min_start_grade mg
WHERE og.start_grade_order = mg.min_order
ORDER BY og.name ASC;

WITH high_schools_with_grade12_enroll AS (
  SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSserved, s.StatusType
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND (',' || s.GSserved || ',' LIKE '%,12,%')
),
sat_takers_by_school AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.cds, SUM(ss.NumTstTakr) AS total_sat_takers
  FROM satscores ss
  GROUP BY ss.cds
),
schools_no_sat AS (
  SELECT 
    hs.CDSCode, hs.School, hs.GSserved
  FROM high_schools_with_grade12_enroll hs
  LEFT JOIN sat_takers_by_school st ON hs.CDSCode = st.cds
  WHERE IFNULL(st.total_sat_takers, 0) = 0
),
school_grades_extracted AS (
  SELECT 
    cds, School,
    TRIM(SUBSTR(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, ',')-1)) AS first_grade,
    GSserved
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      CDSCode AS cds, School, GSserved,
      CASE 
        WHEN INSTR(GSserved, ',') = 0 THEN GSserved || ','
        ELSE GSserved
      END AS GSserved2
    FROM schools_no_sat
  )
),
grade_for_sort AS (
  SELECT 
    cds, School, first_grade, GSserved,
    CASE 
      WHEN first_grade = 'PS' THEN 0
      WHEN first_grade = 'PK' THEN 1
      WHEN first_grade = 'TK' THEN 2
      WHEN first_grade = 'KG' THEN 3
      WHEN CAST(first_grade AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 4
      WHEN CAST(first_grade AS INTEGER) > 1 THEN 3 + CAST(first_grade AS INTEGER)
      ELSE 100
    END AS sort_grade
  FROM school_grades_extracted
)
SELECT School AS school_name, GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM grade_for_sort
WHERE sort_grade = (SELECT MIN(sort_grade) FROM grade_for_sort)
ORDER BY school_name;

SELECT
    SchoolName,
    [School Type],
    Latitude
FROM (
    SELECT
        SchoolName,
        [School Type],
        Latitude,
        MAX(Latitude) OVER () AS MaxLatitude
    FROM schools
    WHERE
        (
            -- School type contains "Middle" or "Junior High" or "Intermediate"
            LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%middle%'
            OR LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%junior high%'
            OR LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%intermediate%'
            -- Or school name contains "Middle" (to match e.g. "Smith Middle School" even if School Type doesn't say "Middle")
            OR LOWER(SchoolName) LIKE '%middle%'
        )
        -- Restrict to California (if data includes other states)
        AND (State IS NULL OR State='CA')
        -- Must have a valid latitude
        AND Latitude IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE Latitude = MaxLatitude
ORDER BY SchoolName;

WITH active_charters AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        FundingType,
        COALESCE(GSserved, GSoffered) AS Grades,
        StatusType,
        Charter
    FROM schools
    WHERE
        Charter = 1
        AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Open')
        AND FundingType IN ('Directly Funded', 'Locally Funded')
),
charters_with_demo AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.FundingType,
        s.StatusType,
        s.Charter,
        -- Enrollment based on K-12: count if GSserved/GSoffered cover grades K-12 (or using a proxy if exact grade span column not provided)
        CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS enroll_k12_2014_15,
        NULL AS frpm_percent_2014_15
    FROM active_charters s
),
sat_score_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sc.FundingType,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sc.CDSCode) AS num_schools,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN c.enroll_k12_2014_15 IS NOT NULL THEN c.enroll_k12_2014_15
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_enrollment,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN c.frpm_percent_2014_15 IS NOT NULL THEN c.frpm_percent_2014_15
            END
        ) AS avg_frpm_percent,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
                THEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite)
            END
        ) AS avg_sat_total
    FROM schools sc
    LEFT JOIN charters_with_demo c
        ON sc.CDSCode = c.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN satscores s
        ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
        AND s.rtype = 'S'
    WHERE sc.Charter = 1
      AND sc.StatusType IN ('Active', 'Open')
      AND sc.FundingType IN ('Directly Funded', 'Locally Funded')
    GROUP BY sc.FundingType
)
SELECT
    FundingType,
    num_schools,
    total_enrollment,
    ROUND(avg_frpm_percent, 2) AS avg_frpm_percent,
    ROUND(avg_sat_total, 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM sat_score_agg
ORDER BY FundingType;

WITH ca_special_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_code,
    s.school_name,
    s.k12enroll_1415,
    s.grdlo AS earliest_grade
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.state = 'CA'
    AND s.schtype = 'Special'
    AND s.schlevel = 'K-12'
    AND s.year = 2015
),
graded_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE earliest_grade
      WHEN 'P' THEN 0
      WHEN 'K' THEN 1
      WHEN '1' THEN 2
      WHEN '2' THEN 3
      WHEN '3' THEN 4
      WHEN '4' THEN 5
      WHEN '5' THEN 6
      WHEN '6' THEN 7
      WHEN '7' THEN 8
      WHEN '8' THEN 9
      WHEN '9' THEN 10
      WHEN '10' THEN 11
      WHEN '11' THEN 12
      WHEN '12' THEN 13
      ELSE 99
    END AS grade_rank
  FROM ca_special_schools
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT
    scode AS school_code,
    SUM(satnum) AS sat_test_takers
  FROM satscores
  WHERE year = 2015
  GROUP BY scode
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    g.school_name,
    g.earliest_grade,
    g.k12enroll_1415,
    COALESCE(s.sat_test_takers, 0) AS sat_test_takers,
    g.grade_rank
  FROM graded_ranked g
  LEFT JOIN sat_counts s ON g.school_code = s.school_code
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  earliest_grade,
  k12enroll_1415,
  sat_test_takers
FROM joined
ORDER BY grade_rank DESC, k12enroll_1415 DESC, school_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

  COUNT(DISTINCT sch.school_id) AS num_schools_operating,
  SUM(sch.k12_enrollment) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  SUM(frpm.k12_frpm_eligible) AS total_k12_frpm_eligible
FROM
  schools sch
  INNER JOIN frpm ON sch.school_id = frpm.school_id
WHERE
  sch.charter_school = 1
  AND sch.operating_agency_type = 'County Office of Education'
  AND sch.school_status = 'Active'
  AND sch.charter_funding_type IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY
  sch.charter_funding_type
ORDER BY
  CASE sch.charter_funding_type
    WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END

    SELECT county_name
    FROM schools
    WHERE cds_code = '1612590125716'
    LIMIT 1
),
eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        f.cds_code,
        s.county_name,
        s.school_name,
        f.charter_indicator,
        f.frpm_eligible,
        f.free_meals,
        f.enroll,
        CASE 
            WHEN f.enroll > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * f.free_meals / f.enroll, 2) 
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS free_meal_pct,
        CASE 
            WHEN f.enroll > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * f.frpm_eligible / f.enroll, 2) 
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.cds_code = s.cds_code
    WHERE 
        s.county_name = (SELECT county_name FROM target_county)
        AND f.school_type = 'K-12'
        AND f.free_meals > 500
        AND f.frpm_eligible < 700
),
charter_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN charter_indicator = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter,
        SUM(CASE WHEN charter_indicator <> 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter
    FROM eligible_schools
),
sat_averages AS (
    SELECT
        e.cds_code,
        (ss.sat_erw_avg_score + ss.sat_math_avg_score + ss.sat_essay_avg_score) AS sat_total
    FROM eligible_schools e
    JOIN satscores ss ON e.cds_code = ss.cds_code
    WHERE ss.sat_erw_avg_score IS NOT NULL 
      AND ss.sat_math_avg_score IS NOT NULL 
      AND ss.sat_essay_avg_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    es.county_name AS county_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT es.cds_code) AS num_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(es.free_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(es.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
    cc.num_charter,
    cc.num_non_charter,
    ROUND(AVG(sa.sat_total), 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM eligible_schools es

GROUP BY es.county_name, cc.num_charter, cc.num_non_charter

WITH fremont_county AS (
  SELECT County AS county_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
target_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    f.CDSCode, 
    f.[County Name] AS county_name, 
    f.[School Type], 
    f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] AS free_meals, 
    f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS frpm_meals,
    ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)], 2) AS pct_free, 
    ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)], 2) AS pct_frpm,
    f.[Charter School (Y/N)] AS charter_ind
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN fremont_county fc ON f.[County Name] = fc.county_name
  WHERE f.[School Type] = 'K-12'
    AND f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] > 500
    AND f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] < 700
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT county_name, COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
         ROUND(AVG(pct_free), 2) AS avg_free_pct,
         ROUND(AVG(pct_frpm), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
         SUM(CASE WHEN charter_ind = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter,
         SUM(CASE WHEN charter_ind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter
  FROM target_schools
),
sat_by_school AS (
  SELECT t.CDSCode, 
         (COALESCE(s.AvgScrRead,0) + COALESCE(s.AvgScrMath,0) + COALESCE(s.AvgScrWrite,0)) AS total_sat
  FROM target_schools t
  JOIN satscores s ON t.CDSCode = s.cds 
  WHERE s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
avg_sat AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_sat), 2) AS avg_sat_score FROM sat_by_school
)
SELECT a.county_name, a.num_schools, a.avg_free_pct, a.avg_frpm_pct, a.num_charter, a.num_non_charter, s.avg_sat_score
FROM avgs a CROSS JOIN avg_sat s;

WITH hs_full_12 AS (
  SELECT
    s.cdscode,
    s.name AS school_name,
    s.GSserved,
    s.charter_flag,
    fm.FreeMealCount,
    fm.Enrollment,
    CASE 
      WHEN fm.Enrollment > 0 THEN CAST(fm.FreeMealCount AS FLOAT) / fm.Enrollment
      ELSE NULL
    END AS free_meal_rate
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm fm ON s.cdscode = fm.cdscode
  WHERE s.county = 'ALAMEDA'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12'
),
max_free_meal AS (
  SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS max_rate
  FROM hs_full_12
  WHERE free_meal_rate IS NOT NULL
),
schools_with_max AS (
  SELECT 
    h.cdscode,
    h.school_name,
    ROUND(h.free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN h.charter_flag = 1 THEN 'Yes'
      WHEN h.charter_flag = 0 THEN 'No'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS is_charter,
    h.GSserved
  FROM hs_full_12 h
  JOIN max_free_meal m ON h.free_meal_rate = m.max_rate
)
SELECT
  swm.school_name,
  swm.free_meal_rate,
  swm.is_charter,
  swm.GSserved AS grades_it_serves,
  CASE
    WHEN ss.math_pct is NULL OR ss.erw_pct is NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    ELSE
      CASE 
        WHEN (ss.math_pct + ss.erw_pct) / 2 < 33 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (ss.math_pct + ss.erw_pct) / 2 >= 33 AND (ss.math_pct + ss.erw_pct) / 2 < 67 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
      END
  END AS sat_performance_level
FROM schools_with_max swm
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON swm.cdscode = ss.cdscode;

WITH eligible_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.GSserved,
    s.Charter,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS free_meal_rate
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] IS NOT NULL
),
max_frpm AS (
  SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS max_rate FROM eligible_schools
),
tied_schools AS (
  SELECT
    es.CDSCode,
    es.school_name,
    ROUND(es.free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE es.Charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS is_charter_school,
    es.GSserved AS grades_served
  FROM eligible_schools es
  JOIN max_frpm m ON es.free_meal_rate = m.max_rate
)
SELECT
  t.school_name,
  t.free_meal_rate,
  t.is_charter_school,
  t.grades_served,
  CASE 
    WHEN ss.AvgScrRead IS NULL AND ss.AvgScrMath IS NULL AND ss.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    ELSE CASE 
      WHEN (IFNULL(ss.AvgScrRead,0) + IFNULL(ss.AvgScrMath,0) + IFNULL(ss.AvgScrWrite,0))/3.0 < 
        (SELECT AVG(totalavg) FROM (SELECT (IFNULL(AvgScrRead,0)+IFNULL(AvgScrMath,0)+IFNULL(AvgScrWrite,0))/3.0 AS totalavg FROM satscores WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL OR AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL OR AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN (IFNULL(ss.AvgScrRead,0) + IFNULL(ss.AvgScrMath,0) + IFNULL(ss.AvgScrWrite,0))/3.0 > 
        (SELECT AVG(totalavg) FROM (SELECT (IFNULL(AvgScrRead,0)+IFNULL(AvgScrMath,0)+IFNULL(AvgScrWrite,0))/3.0 AS totalavg FROM satscores WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL OR AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL OR AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'Above Average'
      ELSE 'Average'
    END
  END AS sat_performance
FROM tied_schools t
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON t.CDSCode = ss.cds
GROUP BY t.CDSCode, t.school_name, t.free_meal_rate, t.is_charter_school, t.grades_served

LIMIT 1000

WITH exclusively_virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT
    school_id,
    school_name,
    county_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE is_exclusively_virtual = 1
),
virtual_school_county_counts AS (
  SELECT
    county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_virtual_schools
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools
  GROUP BY county_name
),
county_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    county_name,
    num_virtual_schools,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC) AS rank
  FROM virtual_school_county_counts
),
fifth_highest_count AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(num_virtual_schools) AS num_virtual_schools
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT num_virtual_schools
    FROM county_ranks
    ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC
    LIMIT 5
  )
),
top_counties AS (
  SELECT
    c.county_name,
    c.num_virtual_schools
  FROM county_ranks c
  JOIN fifth_highest_count f
    ON c.num_virtual_schools >= f.num_virtual_schools
),
county_school_sat AS (
  SELECT
    evs.county_name,
    evs.school_id,
    evs.school_name,
    s.avg_reading_score
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools evs
  LEFT JOIN satscores s
    ON evs.school_id = s.school_id
),
county_max_sat AS (
  SELECT
    county_name,
    MAX(avg_reading_score) AS max_avg_reading_score
  FROM county_school_sat
  GROUP BY county_name
),
best_schools_per_county AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    t.county_name,
    t.num_virtual_schools,
    CASE
      WHEN cms.max_avg_reading_score IS NULL THEN 'None'
      WHEN cs.avg_reading_score = cms.max_avg_reading_score THEN cs.school_name
      ELSE NULL
    END AS school_name
  FROM top_counties t
  LEFT JOIN county_school_sat cs
    ON t.county_name = cs.county_name
  LEFT JOIN county_max_sat cms
    ON t.county_name = cms.county_name
  WHERE cs.avg_reading_score = cms.max_avg_reading_score
     OR cms.max_avg_reading_score IS NULL
)
SELECT
  county_name,
  num_virtual_schools,
  school_name
FROM best_schools_per_county
WHERE school_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC, county_name, school_name

WITH exclusively_virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT
    County,
    School,
    CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE LOWER(Virtual) = 'exclusively virtual'
),
county_virtual_counts AS (
  SELECT
    County,
    COUNT(*) AS exclusively_virtual_count
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools
  GROUP BY County
),
limits AS (
  SELECT exclusively_virtual_count
  FROM county_virtual_counts
  ORDER BY exclusively_virtual_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT MIN(exclusively_virtual_count) AS cutoff
  FROM limits
),
top_counties AS (
  SELECT cvc.County, cvc.exclusively_virtual_count
  FROM county_virtual_counts cvc
  CROSS JOIN threshold t
  WHERE cvc.exclusively_virtual_count >= t.cutoff
),
school_with_scores AS (
  SELECT
    evs.County,
    evs.School,
    evs.CDSCode,
    ss.AvgScrRead
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools evs
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss
    ON evs.CDSCode = ss.cds AND ss.rtype = 'S'
),
ranked_schools AS (
  SELECT
    sws.County,
    sws.School,
    sws.AvgScrRead,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sws.County ORDER BY sws.AvgScrRead DESC)
      AS reading_rank
  FROM school_with_scores sws
  WHERE sws.County IN (SELECT County FROM top_counties)
),
top_school_in_county AS (
  SELECT
    County,
    GROUP_CONCAT(School, ', ') AS top_school_name
  FROM ranked_schools
  WHERE reading_rank = 1 AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY County
),
counties_with_score AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT County FROM top_school_in_county
),
counties_no_reported_scores AS (
  SELECT tc.County
  FROM top_counties tc
  LEFT JOIN counties_with_score cws ON tc.County = cws.County
  WHERE cws.County IS NULL
)
SELECT
  tc.County,
  tc.exclusively_virtual_count,
  COALESCE(tsic.top_school_name, 'None') AS top_school_name
FROM top_counties tc
LEFT JOIN top_school_in_county tsic ON tc.County = tsic.County
ORDER BY tc.exclusively_virtual_count DESC, tc.County;

  SELECT c.set_code, s.release_date
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.set_code = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
  AND c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL
  AND s.release_date = (
    SELECT MIN(ss.release_date)
    FROM cards cc
    JOIN sets ss ON cc.set_code = ss.code
    WHERE cc.name = 'Abyssal Horror' AND cc.mana_cost IS NOT NULL
  )
  ORDER BY s.release_date ASC, c.set_code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Find the set code of the most recently released set
most_recent_set AS (
  SELECT code AS set_code, release_date
  FROM sets
  WHERE release_date = (SELECT MAX(release_date) FROM sets)
  ORDER BY code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
sets_of_interest AS (
  SELECT set_code, release_date FROM abyssal_horror_first_print
  UNION ALL
  SELECT set_code, release_date FROM most_recent_set
),
-- For each set of interest, calculate the stats
set_card_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.set_name,
    s.code AS set_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_with_cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.mana_cost IS NOT NULL AND c.mana_value <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cheap_count
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON c.set_code = s.code
  WHERE s.code IN (SELECT set_code FROM sets_of_interest)
  GROUP BY s.code, s.set_name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(cheap_count AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_with_cost, 0), 2
  ) AS percent_cards_CMC_3_or_less
FROM set_card_stats;

WITH
-- 1. Find all sets containing 'Abyssal Horror'
ah_sets AS (
  SELECT c.setCode
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
-- 2. Get release dates for those sets
ah_set_dates AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets s
  JOIN ah_sets a ON s.code = a.setCode
),
-- 3. Get the "first print" set: earliest date, tiebreak on set code
first_printed_set AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM ah_set_dates
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MIN(releaseDate) FROM ah_set_dates)
  ORDER BY code
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 4. Get the most recent set (latest date, tiebreak on code)
recent_set AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
  ORDER BY code
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 5. Pick both set codes
target_sets AS (
  SELECT code FROM first_printed_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT code FROM recent_set
),
-- 6. Get set names
target_set_names AS (
  SELECT ts.code, s.name
  FROM target_sets ts
  JOIN sets s ON ts.code = s.code
),
-- 7. For each target set, count #cards with manaCost (not null/blank) and # of those with convertedManaCost <= 3
set_mana_stats AS (
  SELECT
    tsn.name AS set_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> '' THEN 1 END) AS cards_with_mana_cost,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> '' AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS cheap_cards
  FROM target_set_names tsn
  JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = tsn.code
  GROUP BY tsn.name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(cheap_cards AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(cards_with_mana_cost, 0)
  , 2) AS percent_cheap_cards
FROM set_mana_stats;

        CASE 
            WHEN t.frame = '1993' THEN 1993
            WHEN t.frame = '1997' THEN 1997
            WHEN t.frame = '2003' THEN 2003
            WHEN t.frame = '2015' THEN 2015
            ELSE NULL
        END AS frame_version_year
    FROM tarmogoyf_printings t
)

    released_at
FROM frame_min_year

), FastBuildUpRatings AS (
  SELECT
    ta.team_api_id,
    ta.date,

      PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id, ta.date

    hw.match_api_id,
    hw.club_api_id,
    hw.home_team_goal,
    hw.away_team_goal,
    hw.date AS match_date,
    ta.date AS rating_date,
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM HomeWins hw
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      ta1.team_api_id, ta1.date, ta1.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
    FROM Team_Attributes ta1
    JOIN (
      SELECT 
        team_api_id, 
        date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) rn
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
    ) ta2
    ON ta1.team_api_id = ta2.team_api_id AND ta1.date = ta2.date AND ta2.rn = 1
    WHERE ta1.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
  ) ta
    ON ta.team_api_id = hw.club_api_id
    AND ta.date = (
      SELECT MAX(ta_sub.date)
      FROM Team_Attributes ta_sub
      WHERE ta_sub.team_api_id = hw.club_api_id
        AND ta_sub.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'

    ta.team_api_id, 
    ta.date AS ta_date, 
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
),
LastFastBuildUpPerMatch AS (
  SELECT 
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,

    MAX(fb.ta_date) AS last_fb_date

QualifiedMatches AS (

WITH prachatice_branch_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id AS branch_district_id, a.date AS account_open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT la.account_id
    FROM loan la
    JOIN prachatice_branch_accounts pba ON la.account_id = pba.account_id
),
account_owners AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, c.client_id, c.district_id AS home_district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_home_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        ba.account_id,
        pba.account_open_date,
        ao.client_id AS owner_client_id,
        ao.home_district_id
    FROM borrowing_accounts ba
    JOIN prachatice_branch_accounts pba ON ba.account_id = pba.account_id
    JOIN account_owners ao ON ba.account_id = ao.account_id
),
district_populations AS (
    SELECT district_id, A3 AS district_name, A4 AS region, A2 AS district_town, A5 AS population
    FROM district
),
total_loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
outside_counterparties AS (
    -- Only trans with type 'PRIJEM' (incoming transfer) or 'VYDAJ' (outgoing transfer) that are not cash (karta, vyber, vklad)
    SELECT 
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank_account) AS num_outside_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
      AND t.operation NOT IN ('VYBER', 'VKLAD', 'VYBER KARTOU', 'POKLADNA') -- exclude cash operations
      AND t.bank = 'czech' -- only bank transfers (assume only non-cash ops in these types)
      AND t.bank_account IS NOT NULL
      AND LENGTH(t.bank_account) > 0
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
final_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ahd.account_id,
        ahd.account_open_date,
        IFNULL(tla.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_borrowed,
        IFNULL(oc.num_outside_counterparties, 0) AS num_outside_counterparties,
        ahd.home_district_id,
        dp.district_town AS home_district_name,
        dp.population AS home_district_population
    FROM account_home_districts ahd
    LEFT JOIN district_populations dp ON ahd.home_district_id = dp.district_id
    LEFT JOIN total_loan_amounts tla ON ahd.account_id = tla.account_id
    LEFT JOIN outside_counterparties oc ON ahd.account_id = oc.account_id
)
SELECT 
    account_id,
    account_open_date,
    total_borrowed,
    num_outside_counterparties,
    home_district_name,
    home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_id ASC
    ) AS home_district_population_rank
FROM final_ranked
ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_id ASC;

treatment.sql:
WITH prachatice_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id AS account_district_id, a.date AS open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
),
pr_account_loans AS (
    SELECT pa.account_id, pa.open_date
    FROM prachatice_accounts pa
    JOIN borrowing_accounts ba ON pa.account_id = ba.account_id
),
owner_info AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, c.district_id AS client_district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_home_pop AS (
    SELECT pr.account_id,
           pr.open_date,
           oi.client_district_id AS home_district_id,
           dist.A2 AS home_district_name,
           dist.A8 AS home_district_population
    FROM pr_account_loans pr
    JOIN owner_info oi ON pr.account_id = oi.account_id
    JOIN district dist ON oi.client_district_id = dist.district_id
),
total_borrowed AS (
    SELECT l.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan l
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
counterparties AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT
            CASE
                WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
                     AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != ''
                     AND t.account IS NOT NULL
                     AND t.account != t.account_id
                THEN t.bank || '-' || t.account
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS num_outside_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
final_table AS (
    SELECT
        ahp.account_id,
        ahp.open_date,
        COALESCE(tb.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_borrowed,
        COALESCE(cp.num_outside_counterparties, 0) AS num_outside_counterparties,
        ahp.home_district_id,
        ahp.home_district_name,
        ahp.home_district_population
    FROM account_home_pop ahp
    LEFT JOIN total_borrowed tb ON ahp.account_id = tb.account_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparties cp ON ahp.account_id = cp.account_id
)
SELECT
    ft.account_id,
    ft.open_date,
    ft.total_borrowed,
    ft.num_outside_counterparties,
    ft.home_district_id,
    ft.home_district_name,
    ft.home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY ft.home_district_population DESC, ft.account_id ASC
    ) AS home_district_population_rank
FROM final_table ft
ORDER BY ft.home_district_population DESC, ft.account_id ASC;

joined_info AS (

    d.disp_id,

),

    c.gender,
    a.district_id AS acc_district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN client_info c ON a.account_id = c.account_id
  JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
  WHERE di.inhabitants > 100000
  GROUP BY c.gender, a.district_id
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    di.district_id,
    di.inhabitants,
    di.avg_salary,
    di.urban_ratio
  FROM district di
),
final_districts AS (
  SELECT
    df.gender,
    ds.district_id,
    ds.inhabitants,
    ds.avg_salary,
    ds.urban_ratio
  FROM districts_filtered df
  JOIN district_stats ds ON df.acc_district_id = ds.district_id
),
per_gender_stats AS (
  SELECT
    gender,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio,
    MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants
  FROM final_districts

),
max_inhab_districts AS (
  SELECT
    f.gender,
    f.district_id,
    f.inhabitants

  JOIN per_gender_stats s

)
SELECT
  s.gender,
  s.district_count,
  m.district_id AS max_inhab_district_id,
  m.inhabitants AS max_inhabitants,
  s.avg_salary,
  s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM per_gender_stats s
JOIN max_inhab_districts m ON s.gender = m.gender
WHERE s.gender IN ('F', 'M')
ORDER BY s.gender, m.district_id
;

WITH
-- 1. Find Litomerice's district_id (A2 is used as district name per schema), then its co-region districts
litomerice_region_districts AS (
  SELECT d2.district_id, d2.A2 AS district_name
  FROM district d1
  JOIN district d2 ON d1.A3 = d2.A3
  WHERE d1.A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
-- 2. Accounts in those districts opened in 1996
accounts_1996 AS (
  SELECT account_id, district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM litomerice_region_districts)
    AND date >= '1996-01-01' AND date <= '1996-12-31'
),
-- 3. For each account, find the latest transaction id on or before 1996-12-31
last_trans_1996 AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, MAX(t.date) AS last_date
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_1996)
    AND t.date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
final_trans_1996 AS (
  SELECT t1.account_id, t1.trans_id, t1.balance
  FROM trans t1
  JOIN last_trans_1996 lt
    ON t1.account_id = lt.account_id AND t1.date = lt.last_date
  WHERE t1.trans_id = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.trans_id)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.account_id = t1.account_id AND t2.date = t1.date
  )
),
-- 4. Join accounts to these balances
acct_bal AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, f.balance
  FROM accounts_1996 a
  JOIN final_trans_1996 f ON a.account_id = f.account_id
),
-- 5. Stats per district
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.district_name,
    COUNT(ab.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_end_of_1996_balance
  FROM acct_bal ab
  JOIN litomerice_region_districts d ON ab.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.district_name
),
-- 6. Region-wide average
region_stats AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_avg_end_1996_balance
  FROM acct_bal
),
-- 7. Best district by average (alphabetic in case of tie)
top_district AS (
  SELECT district_name, avg_end_of_1996_balance
  FROM district_stats
  WHERE avg_end_of_1996_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_end_of_1996_balance) FROM district_stats)
  ORDER BY district_name
  LIMIT 1
)
-- Final output as requested
SELECT
  ds.district_name,
  ds.num_accounts_opened_1996,
  ds.avg_end_of_1996_balance,
  rs.region_avg_end_1996_balance,
  td.district_name AS highest_avg_balance_district,
  td.avg_end_of_1996_balance AS highest_avg_balance
FROM district_stats ds
CROSS JOIN region_stats rs
CROSS JOIN top_district td
ORDER BY ds.district_name;

    el.avg_of_avg_salary AS region_avg_salary,
    -- Calculate completed age on 2026-10-09
    -- birth_number: YYMMDD, if MM>50 => female. If MM>50, true month = MM-50. Year: if YY<26 then 2000+YY else 1900+YY
    ( 
        -- calc birthdate
        WITH b AS (
            SELECT
                el.birth_number,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),1,2) AS INTEGER) AS yy,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),3,2) AS INTEGER) AS mm_raw,
                CAST(SUBSTR(printf('%06d',el.birth_number),5,2) AS INTEGER) AS dd
        )
        SELECT
            ( 
                (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)
                +
                (CASE 
                    WHEN (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) > 0 
                      AND (
                            ( (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) > 0 )
                            AND (
                                ( (mm_raw > 50 ? mm_raw-50 : mm_raw )<10 )
                                OR ( (mm_raw > 50 ? mm_raw-50 : mm_raw )=10 AND dd <= 9 )
                            )
                         )
                    THEN (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END))
                    ELSE (CAST('2026' AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN yy < 26 THEN 2000+yy ELSE 1900+yy END)) -1
                END)
            )
        FROM b
    ) AS completed_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM enriched_loans el
ORDER BY el.amount DESC
;

loans_up_to_1996 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_defaulted,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_repaying,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_paid
    FROM loan

    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_standing AS (
    SELECT account_id,
        CASE
            WHEN n_loans = 0 THEN 'no loan'

            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing_label
    FROM loans_up_to_1996
),
trans_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,

        COUNT(*) AS n_trans
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
balance_series AS (
    -- Compute the running account balance; for each account and transaction, accumulate up to the date of each transaction in 1997

    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

LEFT JOIN peak_balances pb ON ta.account_id = pb.account_id

WITH race_info AS (

    c.name AS circuit_name,

    c.country
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
),
winner_result AS (
  SELECT
    ri.*,
    res.driverId,
    res.positionOrder,
    res.milliseconds AS total_ms
  FROM race_info ri
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = ri.raceId
  WHERE res.positionOrder = 1
),
driver_info AS (
  SELECT
    wr.*,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url
  FROM winner_result wr
  JOIN drivers d ON wr.driverId = d.driverId
)
SELECT
  forename,
  surname,
  url,
  -- Compute local time of finish in Baku (UTC+4). Preference is given to raceinfo.time (RACE UTC time),
  -- then add race duration (milliseconds) to it and convert to Baku local.
  -- There may be nulls for race.time; if so, ignore time calculation.
  CASE
    WHEN utc_time IS NOT NULL AND total_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
      -- Convert race UTC time to seconds, add race duration, then convert to local Baku time (UTC+4).
      time(
        datetime(
          utc_time,                           -- race start utc time (hh:mm:ss)
          printf('+%.3f seconds', total_ms / 1000.0),  -- add race duration
          '+4 hours'                          -- convert to Baku local time (UTC+4)
        )
      ) || '.' || printf('%03d', total_ms % 1000)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS finish_local_time_baku
FROM driver_info
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.code IS NULL
  AND d.forename IN (
      SELECT forename
      FROM drivers
      GROUP BY forename
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) > 1
  )
  AND (
    -- All time columns are for Q1, possible formats: "m:ss.sss", "m:ss", etc.
    -- Qualifying times may be null; times faster than 2 minutes ("2:00.000")
    -- Lower = faster, so need times less than "2:00.000"
    -- SQLite compares string times as text; pad single digit mins to 2 digits
    -- Handle both "m:ss.sss" and null strings, ignore malformed entries
    (
      LENGTH(q.q1) >= 5
      AND (
        -- If time in format "m:ss.xxx", split minute and second
        CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60 +
        CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)
      ) < 120
    )
  )
;

WITH chinese_gp_2000s AS (

    r.name,
    r.circuitId
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
    AND LOWER(r.name) LIKE '%chinese%'
),
with_local_times AS (
  SELECT
    cgp.*,
    c.location,
    c.country,
    strftime('%H:%M', datetime(coalesce(cgp.date, '') || 'T' || coalesce(cgp.time, '00:00'), 'utc', 
      CASE
        -- China Standard Time, UTC+8
        WHEN c.country = 'China' THEN '+8 hours'
        ELSE '+0 hours'
      END)) AS local_start_time
  FROM chinese_gp_2000s cgp
  JOIN circuits c ON cgp.circuitId = c.circuitId
),
earliest_local_time AS (
  SELECT 
    *
  FROM with_local_times
  WHERE local_start_time = (
      SELECT MAX(local_start_time)
      FROM with_local_times
      WHERE local_start_time = (
        SELECT MIN(local_start_time) FROM with_local_times
      )
  ) -- If tied earliest time, return the most recent one (MAX by year)
    AND year = (
      SELECT MAX(year) FROM with_local_times
      WHERE local_start_time = (
        SELECT MIN(local_start_time) FROM with_local_times
      )
    )
),
race_to_analyze AS (
  SELECT raceId, year FROM earliest_local_time
),
runner_up_gap AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r2.positionOrder as runner_up_position,
    r2.driverId as runner_up_driverId,
    r2.time as runner_up_time_raw,
    r1.time as winner_time_raw,
    CASE
      WHEN r2.time IS NOT NULL AND r2.time LIKE '+%' THEN r2.time
      WHEN r2.time IS NOT NULL AND r1.time IS NOT NULL THEN
        -- Both times exist, and stored as canonical times -- calculate gap if possible
        ( 
          -- times are strings, may contain "+X.XXXs"
          -- Fallback: just output runner-up's "time" string  
          r2.time
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS runner_up_time_gap
  FROM results r1
  JOIN results r2 ON r1.raceId = r2.raceId AND r1.positionOrder = 1 AND r2.positionOrder = 2
  WHERE r1.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_to_analyze)
)
SELECT 
  rta.year AS season_year,
  rug.runner_up_time_gap AS runner_up_gap_to_winner
FROM race_to_analyze rta
JOIN runner_up_gap rug ON rta.raceId = rug.raceId;

    datetime(races.date || 'T' || COALESCE(races.time, '00:00:00')) as start_datetime
  FROM races
)

  SELECT
    MIN(start_datetime) AS earliest_time,
    MAX(start_datetime) AS latest_time
  FROM race_times
)

  SELECT circuitId, circuitRef FROM circuits
)
SELECT
  'earliest' AS category,
  c.circuitRef,
  r.start_datetime AS start_time
FROM race_times r
JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_datetime = m.earliest_time
JOIN circuits_map c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'latest' AS category,
  c.circuitRef,
  r.start_datetime AS start_time
FROM race_times r
JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_datetime = m.latest_time
JOIN circuits_map c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId

UNION ALL

  'gap_seconds' AS category,
  NULL AS circuitRef,
  CAST((strftime('%s', m.latest_time) - strftime('%s', m.earliest_time)) AS TEXT) AS gap_in_seconds
FROM min_max_times m;

SELECT
  element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM triple_bond_atoms
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

baseline.sql:
SELECT 
  a.element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS num_atoms_in_bond
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.id = b.atom1_id OR a.id = b.atom2_id
WHERE a.molecule = 'TR397'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element

treatment.sql:
SELECT
  a.element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element
